Circular (Circos-style) genome plot

Source: R/mp_genomics.R
mp_circos.Rd

Draws a circular genome plot with circlize: an ideogram of contigs plus optional coverage, GC, heatmap and annotation tracks and ribbon links (e.g. synteny or correlations). Unlike the other mp_*() functions this draws with base graphics to the current device (the one exception to the ggplot contract) and returns the assembled track data invisibly.

Usage

mp_circos(
  genome,
  coverage = NULL,
  gc = NULL,
  annotations = NULL,
  links = NULL,
  heatmap = NULL,
  coverage.type = c("line", "area", "heatmap"),
  palette = NULL,
  coverage.color = "#0072B2",
  gc.color = "#009E73",
  link.by = NULL,
  link.palette = NULL,
  annotation.by = NULL,
  annotation.palette = NULL,
  heatmap.palette = NULL,
  track.heights = NULL,
  gap = 2,
  start.degree = 90,
  legend = TRUE,
  title = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("micropubr.verbose", FALSE)
)

Arguments

genome

A data frame describing contigs with columns contig and length, or a named numeric vector of lengths.

coverage

Optional coverage data frame with contig, position (or start) and value, plus an optional sample column; or a named list of such data frames (one per sample).

gc

Optional GC-content/skew data frame with contig, start, end and value.

annotations

Optional features with contig, start, end and optional label.

links

Optional ribbon links with contig1, start1, end1, contig2, start2, end2 and an optional weight column (see link.by).

heatmap

Optional data frame for a heatmap track with contig, position (or start), value and an optional row column (one band per row, e.g. per sample).

coverage.type

"line", "area" or "heatmap" (single-sample only).

palette

Palette name or colour vector for contigs / coverage samples.

coverage.color

Colour for a single coverage track.

gc.color

Colour for the GC track.

link.by

Optional numeric column in links used to colour and weight the ribbons.

link.palette

Palette for link.by (defaults to diverging/sequential depending on the sign of the values).

annotation.by

Optional column in annotations (a feature type) used to colour the annotation rectangles.

annotation.palette

Palette for annotation.by.

heatmap.palette

Sequential palette for the heatmap track.

track.heights

Optional named list overriding default track heights (ideogram, coverage, gc, heatmap, annotations).

gap

Gap (degrees) between contigs.

start.degree

Starting angle.

legend

Draw a legend describing the coloured tracks.

title

Optional plot title.

verbose

Print the methods used.

Value

Invisibly, a list of the track data used (so return.data-style workflows still work). Called for the side effect of drawing the plot.

Details

Coverage can hold a sample column (or be a named list of data frames), in which case one coloured line is drawn per sample. Links can be coloured and weighted by a numeric column via link.by (a diverging ramp is used when the values are signed, a sequential ramp otherwise), and annotations can be coloured by feature type via annotation.by.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
genome <- data.frame(contig = c("c1", "c2"), length = c(5000, 3000))
cov <- data.frame(contig = "c1", position = seq(1, 5000, 50),
                  value = runif(100, 10, 100))
links <- data.frame(contig1 = "c1", start1 = 100, end1 = 400,
                    contig2 = "c2", start2 = 800, end2 = 1200,
                    weight = 0.8)
mp_circos(genome, coverage = cov, links = links, link.by = "weight")
} # }
